items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I did the marathon 33 with June Havoc.

ctx.x: And I bought the tenor, which I'm still playing, and went to Freedom Land. Now, during the time at Freedom Land Paul was telling me that the World Fair was coming in, and the next year after I was there, and he wanted a drummer. So the drummer that I took to South America with me, Sol Hall, I put him in touch with Sol. And Sol went out to the World Fair.
Well, the first year of the World Fair I didn't go. I had something else to do. That was '64, I think, and I did some shows. I was doing -- I did the marathon 33 with June Havoc.
